label: od36-current-compact64

lowerBoundPreparation.caveat: Build time measures the existing reverse lower-bound preparation block, including its cache insertion/eviction. No cache policy, size, key, route ordering or result was changed.

ancestry.timingCaveat: Only 1/64 scans are timed, counts/hops are exact at the latest progress/end. Sample elapsed time is not total scan wall-time. Instrumentation overhead and JIT/GC/host scheduling remain.

walkSubqueries.caveat: The original raw acceptedLabels field counted only timed labels; this summary derives exact accepted pushes from expanded+queue for all queries. Worker + descriptive graph metadata define these groups; cross-Worker identities are not assumed equivalent. Different departureS are time-dependent queries, not duplicates.

limitations: Node worker_threads executes instrumented production S1 and production Worker bundles.
DOM stand-ins measure JS/string work, not browser layout, paint or visual acceptance.
CPU collection slightly delays physical Worker termination; timing is diagnostic, compare with same probe.
The original matrix stopped accessible runs as soon as public comparison was usable; this probe observes full completion or the unchanged 60-second window.
